description: This file defines the IconRepository class, which manages icon identifiers for various modules within the SuiteCRM project. It includes a set of class constants for icon categories, a private static mapping of module names to icon labels, and a method to retrieve the icon name for a given module.

classes.name: IconRepository
classes.description: A repository class for managing icon labels associated with different modules in the application.

methods.name: getIconName
methods.description: Returns the icon name for a given module, either from the predefined map or by transforming the module name into a suitable icon label.
